integrity_notes: Proof includes an exact-rational finite inequality certificate and an analytic exhaustion of eligible chord normals. The cited chord-conjecture preprint was first posted on 2026-10-06; that citation date does not establish the first publication date of this record. The original self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only affine images of a regular heptagon, and only quadrilaterals with sides parallel to vertex chords. The 1/40 gap is discrete among support-saturated direction patterns, not metric stability for arbitrary enclosures. No global Kuperberg or arbitrary heptagon statement.
title: Exact chord-quadrilateral enclosure of the regular heptagon
